name: mailing-agent
description: Root scripts for Docker Playwright E2E (browsers run only inside Docker)

scripts.e2e:build: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright build playwright
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e up -d --build
scripts.e2e:test: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm --build playwright
scripts.e2e:test:chromium: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm playwright npx playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:test:smoke: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm playwright npx playwright test --grep "@smoke"
scripts.e2e:test:email: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm playwright npx playwright test --grep "@email"
scripts.e2e:test:visual: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm playwright npx playwright test --grep "@visual" --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:update-snapshots: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm playwright npx playwright test --grep "@visual" --project=chromium --update-snapshots
scripts.e2e:test:headed: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm playwright npm run test:headed
scripts.e2e:test:debug: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm -e PWDEBUG=1 playwright npm run test:debug
scripts.e2e:report: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint "" playwright npx playwright show-report /artifacts/report --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9323
scripts.e2e:down: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright down
scripts.e2e:clean: docker compose -p mailing-agent-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --env-file .env.e2e --profile playwright down -v --remove-orphans
